jobs.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer III
jobs.description:
At  Truckstop , we have transformed the entire freight-moving lifecycle with our SaaS solutions.  From freight matching to payments and everything in between, we are the trusted partner for carriers, brokers, and shippers alike. We lead this industry forward with our One Team mindset committing to principles such as assume positive intent, have each other’s back, and be your authentic self.  Our drive for greatness produces high expectations, yet our regard for humans is even higher. Join a team of brilliant minds and generous hearts who care deeply about other's success.    
 
 
 
 
  Job Summary  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 As a member of the Technology Operations Team, the Lead Infrastructure Engineer role performs work with a high degree of latitude, handling the most complex issues. The Lead Infrastructure Engineer provides expertiseand direction and performs resolution activities. They are evangelists for automation, and work continuously to automate our cloud environment. The Lead Infrastructure Engineer troubleshoots production issues, responds to incidents and lead collaborative efforts to improve system resiliency and reliability. You will be instrumental in optimizing our development pipeline, leveraging our core technologies and will enhance our development lifecycle through robust automation and efficient operational processes. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Essential Job Functions   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 · Understand the requirements of the Technology organization and work with architects to plan out the technical roadmap for the immediate future and long-term pursuits. 
 · Design, Build and implement automated environments using Kubernetes, ensuring scalable, efficient, and resilient orchestration of containerized applications. 
 · Develop, maintain, and optimize Terraform scripts to automate the provisioning and management of Azure infrastructure, aligning with the Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. 
 · Collaborate closely with software engineering teams to understand their needs, ensuring the operational infrastructure supports fast-paced development cycles and high-quality output. 
 · Automate monitoring and alerting systems to proactively identify and address issues, minimizing downtime and maintaining high availability. 
 · Implement security automation, ensuring continuous compliance with industry standards and protection against emerging threats. 
 · Responsible for implemention and management of cloud infrastructure and network including performing research on production issues. 
 · Partner with architects and designers in standardizing and automating system implementation and configuration. 
 · Analyze, execute, and streamline Infrastructure Engineering practices. 
 · Work closely with the platform engineering to design, deliver, and manage our services with high resiliency, availability, and performance. 
 · Partner with network and security teams to implement structure, connectivity, and security of our cloud environments. 
 · Perform incident resolution and root cause analysis of critical outages. Implement solutions to systematic failures. Provide alert response support, including after hours. 
 · Provide subject matter expertise and ability to confidently resolve complex issues with minimal escalation. 
 · Provide technical leadership to Infrastructure Engineering group. 
 · Implement monitoring, develop automated provisioning, and develop self-healing automation. 
 · Provide reporting and management information on infrastructure performance and operational KPIs. 
 · Document the environments and processes that support our products. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The above description covers the most significant duties performed but does not include other related occasional work that may be assigned or is completed by the employee.

jobs.description:
Platform Engineering at  Polar   

 Platform engineering at Polar is about building and evolving the systems that power our product – keeping them fast, resilient and simple as we scale. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents – from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products. 

 Polar sits in the critical path of global payments, billing and financial workflows. Reliability and correctness matter deeply, but so does our ability to move quickly. 

 We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working across infrastructure, backend systems and the application layer – from improving foundational systems and shipping new platform primitives to building the tooling and automation that enable the entire engineering team to move faster. 

 We don’t believe in building infrastructure for infrastructure’s sake. We value a pragmatic mindset and sensibility in knowing when to introduce new abstractions and when the simplest solution is the right one. 

  More about Polar and how we work  

 What you could work on 
 Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include: 

 
 
  Keep Polar reliable at scale:  Designing and evolving systems that remain highly available, performant and resilient as traffic and complexity grow – identifying bottlenecks, improving critical paths and designing for graceful failure. 
 
 
  Evolve our infrastructure:  Improving our cloud architecture, infrastructure-as-code and environments – introducing complexity only where it earns its place. 
 
 
  Make production safe and easy to operate:  Improving observability, debugging, deployments and incident response so engineers can ship confidently, understand what’s happening in production and recover quickly when things go wrong. 
 
 
  Build leverage for engineering:  Creating primitives, abstractions and automation that remove operational toil and help the broader engineering team move faster. 
 
 
  Engineer for financial correctness:  Translating financial and regulatory requirements into robust technical systems, with auditability, access control and data integrity built in from the outset. 
 
 
 What we look for 
 We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine deep systems thinking with exceptional product judgement. People who enjoy solving complex technical problems, take ownership beyond their immediate area and care about building systems that are both robust and easy to work with. 

 Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include: 
 
 
  Strong technical foundations:  Backend and systems engineering experience, including distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operating production systems at scale. This means that you have built and operated such systems over time to see and understand the pitfalls of the initial decisions 
 
 
  SQL and data modelling depth:  Strong experience with relational databases, data modelling, query optimization and designing for data integrity and performance. 
 
 
  Pragmatic engineering judgement:  The ability to reason through complex technical trade-offs, anticipate failure modes and choose solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term maintainability. You’re comfortable moving across infrastructure, backend and application layers to solve the problems that matter.
